chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Leaving Atlanta; Cincinnati tailoring and mechanic job
summary: He left Atlanta in 1922, returned in 1924, then went to Cincinnati for tailoring and worked at Jenning Motor.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: In what year? Can you remember the year that you left Atlanta?
I think, no, I know, I left Atlanta in 1922. My brother was teaching. Then I came back in 1924, went back to school.
Yes, to Morris Brown, boarding school.
What kinds of things were you studying there?

I didn't study nothing; I just went to school, period. I didn't care. That's just the way I lived. So when I left there I went to Cincinnati. I was taking tailoring and when I was in Cincinnati I took tailoring there. I couldn't graduate under my brother; he was too tough... I played with Wes Helvey's band.
1924. During that time I worked in the morning from 8 to 3, the Jenning Motor Company.
What kind of work were you doing?
Mechanic. Then at night I went to school. We had a night school. My three sisters, we went to school together, taking tailoring. I didn't finish but they said I did, so I don't know.
